args.body: Advance CATALOGUE-FIXED-PRICE-DELIVERY-TRIAL under a fresh valid lease if still open. Reuse any completed report. Otherwise read the full director-verifier-controls.json and TASK-179585316100, and read director-fictional-buyer-report.md if the queued check commits it. If the check fails, inspect the actual failing output and use only supported findings in the report. Return one buyer-ready report and a keep, narrow or withdraw decision for the provisional scope. Leave all-in effort unknown unless measured. Close under the actual lease after reading committed evidence, with a lesson covering what worked, what failed and what to change. Keep the report out of the public site pending any later independent exact-digest review.

description: The latest catalogue trial shows the documented verifier accepted the 20-row fictional control. A separate cross-check located a changed barcode and variant image URL by SKU after row reordering. The next step is to turn those results into a private buyer report and verify that the failing run supports both findings before deciding whether to keep the provisional CAD 60 scope. Commercial feedback is available with five unclassified sources and no new interpreted feedback, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded and shows no verified revenue. Order acceptance and settlement require separate administrative evidence. Independent review of the exact release digest still applies to any public change.
